sections.title: Form and cultivation
sections.text: Marjoram is an aromatic perennial subshrub, often grown as an annual in cold regions. It can reach about 80 cm.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The opposite, hairy, oval to rounded leaves are about 3–35 × 2–30 mm. Small white or pinkish flowers are grouped among overlapping bracts.

sections.title: Culinary use
sections.text: The aromatic leaves are used as a culinary herb. Do not confuse it with wild oregano, Origanum vulgare.
